capabilities: Chat with the Pi coding agent via streaming markdown responses
Browse, switch, and export Pi sessions
Run Pi commands from chat input and the command palette
Save conversations as markdown notes in the vault
extras: Desktop only. Manual install via cloning and building the repo (npm install && npm run build) and copying files to the plugins folder. Reads ~/.pi/agent/ configuration via os.homedir(); the README explains that no identity data is collected. Unreviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to interact with a local AI coding agent, so users must leave the app to work with Pi.

relations.evidence: Chat with the Pi coding agent inside Obsidian.

summary: Chat interface for the Pi coding agent inside Obsidian, with streaming markdown rendering, session management, and command integration.
